S={(a,b):int(bl[i].split()[j]) for i,a in enumerate(aas) for j,b in enumerate(aas)}
def sc(a,b): return S.get((a,b),-1)
def nw(s1,s2,gap=-10):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    for i in range(1,n+1):F[i][0]=gap*i;P[i][0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1):F[0][j]=gap*j;P[0][j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=F[i-1][j-1]+sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1]);u=F[i-1][j]+gap;l=F[i][j-1]+gap
            b=max(d,u,l);F[i][j]=b;P[i][j]=0 if b==d else(1 if b==u else 2)
    i,j=n,m;a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=P[i][j]
        if i>0 and j>0 and p==0:a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif i>0 and(j==0 or p==1):a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');i-=1
        else:a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    return a1[::-1],a2[::-1]

ref=seqs['SULT1A1']
pocket_nums=[21,24,47,48,51,76,77,81,84,89,90,106,108,142,146,148,149,240,243,247,248,255]
order=['SULT1A1','SULT1A2','SULT1A3','SULT1E1','SULT1B1','SULT1C2','SULT1C4']
tab={'SULT1A1':[ref[p-1] for p in pocket_nums]}
for name in order:
    if name=='SULT1A1':continue
    a1,a2=nw(ref,seqs[name]);rp=0;mp={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-':rp+=1;mp[rp]=c2
    tab[name]=[mp.get(p,'-') for p in pocket_nums]
idx=[f"{ref[p-1]}{p}" for p in pocket_nums]
df=pd.DataFrame(tab,index=idx)[order]
ref_col=tab['SULT1A1']
diff=np.array([[0 if tab[n][i]==ref_col[i] else 1 for n in order] for i in range(len(pocket_nums))])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,9))
ax.imshow(diff,cmap='Reds',vmin=0,vmax=1.6,aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(order)));ax.set_xticklabels(order,rotation=45,ha='right',fontsize=10)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(idx)));ax.set_yticklabels(idx,fontsize=9)
for i in range(len(pocket_nums)):
    for j,n in enumerate(order):
        ax.text(j,i,df[n].iloc[i],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9,

for i,p in enumerate(pocket_nums):
    if p==146: ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((-0.5,i-0.5),len(order),1,fill=False,edgecolor='blue',lw=2.5))
    if p in(108,106): ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((-0.5,i-0.5),len(order),1,fill=False,edgecolor='green',lw=1.5))
ax.set_title("SULT1A1 acceptor-pocket residues (PDB 1LS6/2D06 <4.5A of acceptor)\nred=differs from SULT1A1; blue=Glu146 specificity switch; green=catalytic K106/H108",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig('sult_pocket_comparison.png',dpi=140)
print("Figure saved: sult_pocket_comparison.png")
print(df.to_string())
print("\nPocket positions differing from SULT1A1:")
for n in order[1:]:
    ndf=sum(diff[i][order.index(n)] for i in range(len(pocket_nums)))
    print(f"  {n}: {ndf}/{len(pocket_nums)}")
print("Aromatic (F/Y/W) residues in SULT1A1 pocket:",sum(1 for p in pocket_nums if ref[p-1] in 'FYW'),"of",len(pocket_nums))
